CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetTempDirectory

Returns the absolute path of a directory where templates may create scratch files. The path ends with a directory separator, so you can append a file name directly.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetTempDirectory()

Returns

The temporary directory, ending with a separator.

Usage

In KoldFusion this is the temp directory under the server's install directory (the "C:\CFUSION" of the Windows product). Be a good neighbor and delete the files you create there. To get a unique file name in it, use GetTempFile.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET TempDir = GetTempDirectory()>
<CFSET Scratch = TempDir & "snippet_" & CreateUUID() & ".txt">
<CFFILE ACTION="WRITE" FILE="#Scratch#" OUTPUT="Written at #TimeFormat(Now(), 'HH:mm:ss')#">
<CFFILE ACTION="READ" FILE="#Scratch#" VARIABLE="Back">
<CFFILE ACTION="DELETE" FILE="#Scratch#">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Temporary directory: <TT>#TempDir#</TT> (exists: #DirectoryExists(TempDir)#)
<P>We wrote, read back and deleted <TT>#GetFileFromPath(Scratch)#</TT>: "#Trim(Back)#"
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

GetTempFile, DirectoryExists, CFFILE
